title: fagus americana
intro: Fagus americana, commonly known as the American beech, is a deciduous tree native to eastern North America. The American beech is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Fagus americana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
